title: Profile
description: Current-user profile editor. Uses `core-data` `useEntityRecord('root','user', userId)`. Edits name fields, email, website, bio, interface language (`locale`), and a basic new-password change.

userId.description: User id to edit. The /users/{id}/edit route interpolates {id} here so the form targets the named user. Absent (e.g. the self-service /profile screen) → falls back to window.wpAdminWorkspaces.userId (the acting user).

documentation.purpose: Profile editor for the user named by `config.userId` (the acting user, `window.wpAdminWorkspaces.userId`, when `config.userId` is absent). Edits first/last/nickname, display name (chosen from a generated option set), email, website, biographical info, interface language (`locale`), and a basic new-password change under an 'Account Management' section. Reads + writes go through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('root', 'user', userId)`; the save button is disabled until `hasEdits` (or a new password is entered) and shows a loading state while `isSaving`. The new password is write-only (never returned by REST), held in local state and folded into the entity edits at save time with a client-side confirm-match check (the confirm-mismatch Notice clears as soon as the user retypes the confirm field) — there is no current-password re-auth and no server-side weak-password gate (REST accepts any non-backslash password). `useEntitySave` is called with entity coords (`{ kind:'root', name:'user', recordId:userId }`) so REST 4xx/5xx failures are caught via `getLastEntitySaveError` and surfaced as error banners rather than false-positive success snackbars. Success + error route through `@wordpress/notices` snackbar / banner. Covers both the own-profile sub-screen of wp-admin's `users.php?action=editself` flow and (via `config.userId`) the `user-edit.php` edit surface the `core:users` Edit action routes to; the multi-user list lives in `core:users` (`docs/screens/users.md`).

reads.purpose: Profile fields of the edited user (config.userId, else the acting user).
Interface-language select options (Site Default + English + installed locales) built by PHP `wp_admin_workspaces_get_profile_languages()`. Falls back to a Site Default + English pair when absent.
User id to edit (interpolated from the /users/{id}/edit route); falls back to the acting user when absent.
Identify the acting user (fallback when config.userId is absent); absence of both shows a permission-denied message.

writes.purpose: Save accumulated `edit()` calls via `save()` from useEntityRecord — includes `locale` (interface language) and, when entered, `password` (write-only, folded in at save time).

states.renders: Form with the eight fields (incl. interface language) populated + empty password section; Save button disabled.
Same form with Save enabled; field edits report dirty-state to kernel (a pending password alone does not — it is local state until save).
Inline error Notice under the password fields; save is aborted until the two match. The Notice is cleared immediately when the user retypes the confirm field (onChange).
Save button shows loading spinner + disabled state.

interactions.effect: `edit({ name: value })` with options generated from username / first / last / first+last / last+first / nickname / current name.
`edit({ locale: value })`; empty value ('') resets to Site Default. Only installed locales + English are offered (REST `locale` enum); installing a new pack on save is wp-admin-only and not surfaced.

Held in local state. Retyping the confirm field clears any pending mismatch Notice immediately. On Save: if the two differ, an inline error Notice shows and save aborts; if they match, `edit({ password })` then `save()`. Cleared on success.
Optionally folds the new password into the edits, then `await save()`; on success: success snackbar + password fields cleared. On failure: error banner with `err.message`.

a11y.focus-management: Form fields are in document order; native focus order is sufficient.

constraints.note: `useEntityRecord('root','user', userId)` returns `{ record: null }` while loading. Reading `record.first_name` without a guard crashes on first paint.

Display name dropdown options are computed in render from the record's name fields. A field combination that produces only one option still renders the select; the user is forced to keep that option even if it's not what they want.

Manifest declares `core:dirty-state: true`. The app does NOT call `useDirtyState` directly — it relies on `hasEdits` being read by a sibling NavigationGuard. (`block-navigation-on-dirty` is intentionally not set; profile edits are low-stakes.)
WPDS `InputControl` onChange takes a DOM event (`e.target.value`), not the raw value. The same applies wherever WPDS form fields are used.
Uses legacy `TextareaControl` from `@wordpress/components` — WPDS 0.12 has no port.
Uses legacy `SelectControl` from `@wordpress/components` for the display name (WPDS 0.12 SelectControl has no `__nextHasNoMarginBottom` parity).

The new-password field has NO current-password re-authentication (REST does not require it) and NO server-side weak-password gate — `WP_REST_Users_Controller` accepts any password except those containing a backslash (`check_user_password`). The app only enforces a client-side confirm-match. The classic wp-admin pass1/pass2 + zxcvbn strength meter + `pw_weak` confirm checkbox are intentionally not reproduced. `password` is never returned by REST, so it lives in local state (not the entity record) and is folded into the edits at save time.

Interface Language offers only Site Default + English + already-installed locales (the REST `locale` enum is `en_US` + `get_available_languages()` plus '' for site default). Installing a downloadable language pack on save is a wp-admin-only sub-feature and is deliberately not offered. REST resolves `locale` via `get_user_locale()`, so a site-default user reads back the resolved site locale (not '') — selecting Site Default ('') writes the reset.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Form layout + text / URL / email / password inputs + password-mismatch Notice + save button.
Bio textarea + display-name select + loading spinner — WPDS 0.12 gaps.
